headline: UK moves military aircraft to hangars at night over potential drone threats
label: NEWS
caption:
British military aircraft are reportedly being moved into hangars at night to protect them from potential drone threats 🛩️

According to Reuters and Sky News, the Royal Air Force has been taking precautions to safeguard its planes amid growing security concerns.

Media reports indicate that the night time movements are a direct response to the risk posed by unauthorized drones near military sites.

Defense officials have not yet released detailed operational specifics regarding the exact locations affected by the new security protocol.
